population: The original ten Read confirmation source seeds and N=1..10. Select independently within each Enumeration format; match Qwen/Gemma directed pairs within that format.
eligibility: Both models have one-to-one parsed traces, a correct baseline count, and the frozen legal answer_query_v3 at both endpoints. No Update format/no-index gate.
pair_selection: Intersect eligible counts within each seed and format. From consecutive edges in the sorted common count grid, select distinct edges nearest midpoint anchors 1.5 then 9.5; break ties by smaller count gap then lower count. Run both directions of each edge.
insufficient_counts_policy: Record all eligible counts and stop before GPU freezing; do not silently change pairs per seed, alias seeds, or select using patch outcomes.
layer_indexing: Zero-based internally; test every decoder block. One-based labels in paper.
smoke_rule: First two changed pairs per model, covering both directions; require zero self delta and exact self-versus-unmodified token replay, regardless of gold correctness. Donor success is not a technical gate.
primary_estimand: Donor-count adoption averaged across four directed pairs within each source seed, then equally across ten seeds; compare with paired self control.
invalid_or_truncated_output_policy: Keep in all relevant denominators; missing or out-of-range answer fails adoption.
gpu_prerequisite: Wait for the newly requested fixed N10 Qwen layer comparison to complete; never interrupt active jobs.
chronology: Post-v2 outcomes amendment on reused source inputs. Only changed directed pairs are newly executed; common pairs retain original raw evidence. This is not independent confirmation.
selection_amendment: User requested Native eligibility after observing v2 outcomes. Restore original baseline-correct/one-to-one/query eligibility and identical low/high pair selector; no clean-replay correctness screen. Keep all replay failures in denominators.
self_reference: Self must match exact tokens of unmodified query replay and make zero state change. Gold correctness and donor adoption are outcomes; preserve all errors.
